title: 交叉隧道人工地盤凍結~Ground freezing for tunnel cross-passages
focus: 凍結壁閉合、地下水熱輸送與融沉控制~Frozen-wall closure, groundwater heat transport and thaw settlement
summary: 人工地盤凍結透過冷卻與相變暫時增加地層強度並減少滲流，卻同時引入熱量、凍脹及解凍變形問題。本課將凍結管幾何、對流熱輸送、長期潛變與備援冷量分開檢查，再建立從臨時凍土支護轉交永久襯砌的證據與停留點。~Artificial ground freezing temporarily strengthens ground and restricts seepage through cooling and phase change, while introducing thermal, heave and thaw-deformation concerns. The course separately examines pipe geometry, advective heat, creep and cooling reserves, then builds evidence and hold points for transferring support from frozen soil to the permanent lining.

units.title: 相變熱量的機理與驗證~Latent heat mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 凍結不只是把溫度降到零度以下，孔隙水由液態轉成冰還需移除潛熱。含水量、鹽分及未凍水比例決定熱量與強度的關係；測得局部低溫不代表整個目標體積已形成連續、足夠厚且可承載的凍土體。此式只計相變潛熱，未含土粒顯熱、管路損失及流動地下水帶入熱量，因此不能直接用來決定實際凍結工期或設備容量。~Freezing requires more than lowering temperature below zero: converting pore water to ice also removes latent heat. Water content, salinity and unfrozen water govern the relation between heat and strength. A cold local reading does not establish a continuous frozen body with adequate thickness and resistance throughout the target volume. This expression includes latent heat only, excluding soil sensible heat, pipe losses and heat carried by flowing groundwater; it cannot directly determine field freezing duration or plant capacity.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設需要相變的水質量m=1000 kg、潛熱Lf=334 kJ/kg，Q=mLf=334000 kJ。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For water mass m=1000 kg undergoing phase change and latent heat Lf=334 kJ/kg, Q=mLf=334000 kJ. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以取樣含水量、鹽分及溫度曲線建立焓模型，核對熱量移除紀錄與凍結範圍。材料試驗需保留土種、含鹽量與未凍水假設；冷凍及地工設計者共同確認熱模型後才設定閉合判據。~Build an enthalpy model from sampled water content, salinity and temperature curves, comparing extracted heat with inferred freezing extent. Retain soil type, salinity and unfrozen-water assumptions in testing; refrigeration and geotechnical designers jointly confirm the thermal model before closure criteria are set.
units.failure: 忽略潛熱會低估冷量需求，造成局部低溫卻遲遲不能形成完整凍結壁。此式只計相變潛熱，未含土粒顯熱、管路損失及流動地下水帶入熱量，因此不能直接用來決定實際凍結工期或設備容量。~Ignoring latent heat underestimates cooling demand, giving cold local readings without completion of the frozen barrier. This expression includes latent heat only, excluding soil sensible heat, pipe losses and heat carried by flowing groundwater; it cannot directly determine field freezing duration or plant capacity.
units.misconception: 溫度低於零度就表示所有孔隙水已全部結冰。~A temperature below zero means all pore water is frozen.
units.practice: 材料試驗需保留土種、含鹽量與未凍水假設；冷凍及地工設計者共同確認熱模型後才設定閉合判據。此式只計相變潛熱，未含土粒顯熱、管路損失及流動地下水帶入熱量，因此不能直接用來決定實際凍結工期或設備容量。~Retain soil type, salinity and unfrozen-water assumptions in testing; refrigeration and geotechnical designers jointly confirm the thermal model before closure criteria are set. This expression includes latent heat only, excluding soil sensible heat, pipe losses and heat carried by flowing groundwater; it cannot directly determine field freezing duration or plant capacity.

units.title: 凍結管交疊的機理與驗證~Freeze-pipe overlap mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 相鄰凍結管周圍的低溫區需連成完整屏障，管距及鑽孔偏斜決定最薄弱的中間位置。均勻圓形凍結半徑只是簡化，地下水流會使凍土範圍不對稱；井內靠近管壁的低溫因此不能替代管間最暖點的閉合證據。幾何交疊只是理想等半徑判斷，沒有證明溫度、強度或水密；鹽分和地下水對流可能使實際閉合時間大幅不同。~Cold zones around adjacent pipes must join into a continuous barrier, with spacing and drilling deviation governing the weakest midpoint. Circular uniform freezing radii are an idealization; groundwater flow makes the frozen body asymmetric. Low temperatures near pipe walls therefore cannot replace closure evidence at the warmest positions between pipes. Geometric overlap assumes equal ideal radii and proves neither temperature, strength nor sealing; salinity and groundwater advection can substantially alter actual closure time.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設兩管中心距s=1.2 m、各凍結半徑r=0.65 m，幾何間隙g=s−2r=−0.10 m，表示重疊0.10 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For spacing s=1.2 m and equal freezing radius r=0.65 m, gap g=s−2r=−0.10 m, indicating 0.10 m geometric overlap. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 量測鑽孔軌跡並在預測最暖區配置測溫孔，對照三維等溫面與實際管位。管位偏差圖與測溫孔應共同驗收；開挖放行由設計者依最不利連續路徑判定，不以平均低溫取代。~Measure bore trajectories and locate temperature holes in predicted warm zones, comparing three-dimensional isotherms with actual pipe positions. Accept pipe deviations and temperature-hole positions together; the designer releases excavation from the most adverse continuous path, not from average cold readings.
units.failure: 管位偏差可能留下狹窄未凍通道，平均溫度合格仍會在開口時產生集中湧水。幾何交疊只是理想等半徑判斷，沒有證明溫度、強度或水密；鹽分和地下水對流可能使實際閉合時間大幅不同。~Pipe deviation can leave a narrow unfrozen channel that admits concentrated inflow despite an acceptable mean temperature. Geometric overlap assumes equal ideal radii and proves neither temperature, strength nor sealing; salinity and groundwater advection can substantially alter actual closure time.
units.misconception: 所有凍結管出水都很冷就代表凍土壁已閉合。~Cold return fluid from every pipe proves closure of the frozen wall.
units.practice: 管位偏差圖與測溫孔應共同驗收；開挖放行由設計者依最不利連續路徑判定，不以平均低溫取代。幾何交疊只是理想等半徑判斷，沒有證明溫度、強度或水密；鹽分和地下水對流可能使實際閉合時間大幅不同。~Accept pipe deviations and temperature-hole positions together; the designer releases excavation from the most adverse continuous path, not from average cold readings. Geometric overlap assumes equal ideal radii and proves neither temperature, strength nor sealing; salinity and groundwater advection can substantially alter actual closure time.

units.title: 對流熱輸送的機理與驗證~Advective heat mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 流動地下水會持續把熱量帶進凍結區，可能使凍結壁迎水側與背水側形成不同厚度。熱輸送取決於水量與溫差，不只取決於土壤導熱係數；若地下水通道集中在薄砂層，整體平均滲透係數可能低估局部熱障礙。算例為水流顯熱負荷，未含相變與導熱；流量本身會隨凍結堵塞而變化，不能假設整個過程維持固定熱輸入。~Flowing groundwater continuously brings heat into the freezing zone and can produce different upstream and downstream thicknesses. Heat transport depends on discharge and temperature difference as well as conductivity. Concentrated flow in a thin sand layer may create a local thermal obstacle that an average ground permeability fails to represent. This is an advective sensible-heat load, excluding phase change and conduction; discharge itself changes as freezing restricts flow, so heat input need not remain constant throughout.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、比熱c=4.18 kJ/(kg·K)、流量q=0.001 m³/s、降溫ΔT=10 K，P=ρcqΔT=41.8 kW。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For ρ=1000 kg/m³, c=4.18 kJ/(kg·K), q=0.001 m³/s and ΔT=10 K, P=ρcqΔT=41.8 kW. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 使用分層水壓與抽水試驗推估流向，對照測溫面是否沿含水層偏移，核對熱平衡殘差。熱水力模型應分列集中流路與平均流場；異常暖區需由冷凍及水文設計者共同解釋，才可改變開挖時程。~Infer flow direction from multilevel pressures and hydraulic tests, compare thermal-front displacement along aquifers, and examine heat-balance residuals. Separate concentrated flow paths from the average field in the thermal-hydraulic model; refrigeration and hydrogeological designers explain warm anomalies before excavation timing changes.
units.failure: 局部高速水流可能維持未凍通道，若只增加冷卻時間而不查熱源，閉合可能始終無法完成。算例為水流顯熱負荷，未含相變與導熱；流量本身會隨凍結堵塞而變化，不能假設整個過程維持固定熱輸入。~A local high-flow path may remain unfrozen; simply extending cooling without identifying the heat source may never achieve closure. This is an advective sensible-heat load, excluding phase change and conduction; discharge itself changes as freezing restricts flow, so heat input need not remain constant throughout.
units.misconception: 只要冷凍機持續運轉，任何地下水流量都能自然克服。~Continuous refrigeration can automatically overcome any groundwater flow rate.
units.practice: 熱水力模型應分列集中流路與平均流場；異常暖區需由冷凍及水文設計者共同解釋，才可改變開挖時程。算例為水流顯熱負荷，未含相變與導熱；流量本身會隨凍結堵塞而變化，不能假設整個過程維持固定熱輸入。~Separate concentrated flow paths from the average field in the thermal-hydraulic model; refrigeration and hydrogeological designers explain warm anomalies before excavation timing changes. This is an advective sensible-heat load, excluding phase change and conduction; discharge itself changes as freezing restricts flow, so heat input need not remain constant throughout.

units.title: 熱擴散尺度的機理與驗證~Thermal diffusion scale mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 溫度擾動向土體內傳遞需要時間，傳遞距離加倍時，純擴散的代表時間約增為四倍。這個尺度幫助辨識管距敏感度，卻沒有包含冰水相變與地下水對流；不能把擴散時間直接當成凍結壁已滿足開挖條件的時刻。這是量綱一致的擴散估算，不是史蒂芬相變問題的完整解；材料溫度依存性與鹽水凍結區間仍須另外處理。~Temperature changes take time to propagate through soil, and doubling distance approximately quadruples a pure-diffusion time scale. This helps identify spacing sensitivity but excludes phase change and groundwater advection. The diffusion time cannot therefore be treated as the instant when a frozen wall satisfies excavation requirements. This is a dimensionally consistent diffusion estimate, not a full Stefan phase-change solution; temperature-dependent properties and a saline freezing interval require separate treatment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：傳熱距離L=0.5 m、熱擴散率α=1×10⁻⁶ m²/s，t*=L²/α=250000 s=2.89 day。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For thermal length L=0.5 m and diffusivity α=1×10⁻⁶ m²/s, t*=L²/α=250000 s=2.89 day. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以不同距離測溫孔比較反應延遲，檢查純導熱模型是否系統性低估最暖點的降溫時間。計畫中分開標示熱尺度、預測閉合時間與驗收停留點；開挖決策須由設計者依實測連續溫度場核准。~Compare thermal response delays at different distances and check whether conduction-only analysis systematically underestimates cooling time at the warmest point. Distinguish thermal scale, predicted closure and acceptance hold point in the plan; the designer approves excavation from the measured continuous temperature field.
units.failure: 把擴散尺度當成完工工期會提前開挖，凍結壁可能仍有薄弱區或未達所需低溫強度。這是量綱一致的擴散估算，不是史蒂芬相變問題的完整解；材料溫度依存性與鹽水凍結區間仍須另外處理。~Treating a diffusion scale as completion time can release excavation while the wall remains locally thin or lacks the required low-temperature strength. This is a dimensionally consistent diffusion estimate, not a full Stefan phase-change solution; temperature-dependent properties and a saline freezing interval require separate treatment.
units.misconception: 公式算出三天就保證三天後所有凍土都能承載。~A three-day diffusion calculation guarantees load-bearing frozen soil after three days.
units.practice: 計畫中分開標示熱尺度、預測閉合時間與驗收停留點；開挖決策須由設計者依實測連續溫度場核准。這是量綱一致的擴散估算，不是史蒂芬相變問題的完整解；材料溫度依存性與鹽水凍結區間仍須另外處理。~Distinguish thermal scale, predicted closure and acceptance hold point in the plan; the designer approves excavation from the measured continuous temperature field. This is a dimensionally consistent diffusion estimate, not a full Stefan phase-change solution; temperature-dependent properties and a saline freezing interval require separate treatment.

units.title: 凍土潛變的機理與驗證~Frozen-soil creep mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 凍土的承載不只由瞬間抗壓強度決定，溫度接近融點或長時間受力時會發生潛變。交叉通道開挖改變凍結壁的形狀及受力路徑，永久襯砌未閉合前的暴露時間因此直接影響變形需求，必須用相應溫度與持續時間評估。平均應力不代表凍土容許應力，局部拉應力與剪應力也可能控制；設計材料參數必須對應實際溫度範圍與時間尺度。~Frozen-soil resistance depends on more than instantaneous compressive strength because creep develops under sustained load, especially near thawing. Cross-passage excavation changes frozen-wall geometry and load paths. Exposure before permanent lining closure therefore directly affects deformation demand and must be evaluated at the relevant temperature and loading duration. Mean stress is not an allowable frozen-soil stress, and local tension or shear may govern; design properties must correspond to the actual temperature range and time scale.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設凍土受壓力N=1200 kN、有效面積A=4 m²，平均σ=N/A=300 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For frozen-ground compression N=1200 kN over effective area A=4 m², mean σ=N/A=300 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 在代表溫度下做持續載重材料試驗，配合洞內收斂與溫度資料，檢查變形速率是否加速。排程應把凍結支護使用時間與襯砌閉合時間連結；延誤時由地工設計者重新評估潛變與維持冷量。~Run sustained-load material tests at representative temperatures and compare convergence and temperature records for accelerating deformation rates. Link frozen-support duration to lining closure in the programme; delays require the geotechnical designer to reassess creep and sustained cooling demand.
units.failure: 低溫試體的短期強度若誤用於較暖且長期受壓區，可能出現逐步收斂及支護超載。平均應力不代表凍土容許應力，局部拉應力與剪應力也可能控制；設計材料參數必須對應實際溫度範圍與時間尺度。~Applying cold-specimen short-term strength to warmer, sustained-loading zones may lead to progressive convergence and overloaded support. Mean stress is not an allowable frozen-soil stress, and local tension or shear may govern; design properties must correspond to the actual temperature range and time scale.
units.misconception: 凍土短期抗壓試驗合格就不需要考慮施工等待時間。~Passing a short-term frozen-soil compression test makes waiting time irrelevant.
units.practice: 排程應把凍結支護使用時間與襯砌閉合時間連結；延誤時由地工設計者重新評估潛變與維持冷量。平均應力不代表凍土容許應力，局部拉應力與剪應力也可能控制；設計材料參數必須對應實際溫度範圍與時間尺度。~Link frozen-support duration to lining closure in the programme; delays require the geotechnical designer to reassess creep and sustained cooling demand. Mean stress is not an allowable frozen-soil stress, and local tension or shear may govern; design properties must correspond to the actual temperature range and time scale.

units.title: 凍結壁滲流的機理與驗證~Frozen-wall seepage mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 冰填充孔隙後滲透性會下降，但未凍水、砂層與管間缺口仍可能形成連通通道。達西流量可描述理想均質屏障的量級，實際水密控制往往由最薄弱路徑主導；觀察少量出水也應檢查它是否攜砂及是否隨時間增大。達西模型假設層流與代表性滲透係數，無法描述開裂集中流；本式的低流量不能取代整體凍結壁連續性證據。~Ice reduces pore connectivity, but unfrozen water, sand seams and pipe gaps can preserve connected pathways. Darcy flow gives the scale for an ideal homogeneous barrier, whereas actual sealing is often controlled by the weakest path. Even small inflow requires checks for transported sediment and increasing discharge with time. Darcy modelling assumes laminar flow and representative permeability and does not describe concentrated fracture flow; this small calculated discharge cannot replace evidence of barrier continuity.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、滲流面積A=20 m²、水力坡降i=5，Q=kAi=1×10⁻⁶ m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, seepage area A=20 m² and gradient i=5, Q=kAi=1×10⁻⁶ m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 比對水壓差與分區集水量，檢查溫度異常及混濁度，將滲流位置與實際凍結管軌跡疊圖。開挖前的水密驗證須使用核定方法且控制擾動；地工與水文負責人共同確認異常出水的停止條件。~Compare pressure difference and zoned collection flows, check temperature anomalies and turbidity, and overlay seepage locations on actual pipe trajectories. Use an approved, disturbance-controlled sealing verification before excavation; geotechnical and hydrogeological leads jointly define stop conditions for anomalous inflow.
units.failure: 未凍通道可能在開挖卸壓後擴大，湧水攜砂會使凍結壁局部侵蝕並改變支護形狀。達西模型假設層流與代表性滲透係數，無法描述開裂集中流；本式的低流量不能取代整體凍結壁連續性證據。~An unfrozen path can enlarge after excavation pressure release; sediment-carrying inflow may erode the frozen wall and change its support geometry. Darcy modelling assumes laminar flow and representative permeability and does not describe concentrated fracture flow; this small calculated discharge cannot replace evidence of barrier continuity.
units.misconception: 凍結後的土體可以永遠視為絕對不透水。~Frozen ground can always be treated as completely impermeable.
units.practice: 開挖前的水密驗證須使用核定方法且控制擾動；地工與水文負責人共同確認異常出水的停止條件。達西模型假設層流與代表性滲透係數，無法描述開裂集中流；本式的低流量不能取代整體凍結壁連續性證據。~Use an approved, disturbance-controlled sealing verification before excavation; geotechnical and hydrogeological leads jointly define stop conditions for anomalous inflow. Darcy modelling assumes laminar flow and representative permeability and does not describe concentrated fracture flow; this small calculated discharge cannot replace evidence of barrier continuity.

units.title: 凍脹差異的機理與驗證~Differential frost heave mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 凍脹與水分遷移及冰透鏡生長有關，不只是原有孔隙水的體積膨脹。地層約束及補水路徑使地表或既有隧道產生不均勻隆起；結構常由差異變位而非平均抬升量控制，監測因此須跨越凍結區邊界。角變形是兩點平均坡度，不等於構件曲率或接縫開口；若剛體轉動佔主要部分，應與真正畸變分開判讀。~Frost heave involves water migration and ice-lens growth, not merely expansion of existing pore water. Ground restraint and water supply cause uneven uplift of the surface or existing tunnels. Structures are often governed by differential movement rather than mean heave, so monitoring must span the boundary of the freezing zone. Angular distortion here is a two-point mean slope, not member curvature or joint opening; separate rigid-body rotation where it dominates from actual structural distortion.
units.model: 原創教學假設：兩點差異抬升Δs=6 mm、間距L=12 m=12000 mm，角變形β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For differential heave Δs=6 mm over L=12 m=12000 mm, angular distortion β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用精密水準及隧道收斂測點追蹤凍結區內外差異，將位移方向與水位、溫度歷程比對。變形允收需依資產接縫與管線能力制定；凍結區變更前，由資產管理者和設計者確認監測涵蓋範圍。~Track differential movement inside and outside the freezing zone with precise levelling and tunnel convergence, comparing directions with water levels and temperature history. Set movement criteria from asset-joint and utility capacity; the asset owner and designer confirm monitoring coverage before the freezing zone is changed.
units.failure: 地表抬升看似均勻時，接縫附近仍可能集中轉角；既有管線的脆性接頭可能先開裂。角變形是兩點平均坡度，不等於構件曲率或接縫開口；若剛體轉動佔主要部分，應與真正畸變分開判讀。~Apparently uniform surface heave can still concentrate rotation near joints, allowing brittle connections in existing utilities to crack first. Angular distortion here is a two-point mean slope, not member curvature or joint opening; separate rigid-body rotation where it dominates from actual structural distortion.
units.misconception: 凍脹只要總抬升不大就不會損傷周邊結構。~Small total frost heave cannot damage neighbouring structures.
units.practice: 變形允收需依資產接縫與管線能力制定；凍結區變更前，由資產管理者和設計者確認監測涵蓋範圍。角變形是兩點平均坡度，不等於構件曲率或接縫開口；若剛體轉動佔主要部分，應與真正畸變分開判讀。~Set movement criteria from asset-joint and utility capacity; the asset owner and designer confirm monitoring coverage before the freezing zone is changed. Angular distortion here is a two-point mean slope, not member curvature or joint opening; separate rigid-body rotation where it dominates from actual structural distortion.

units.title: 冷量備援的機理與驗證~Cooling reserve mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 冷凍設備停機後，凍土吸收外部熱量並逐步升溫，尚未完全融化前其強度也可能下降。可用熱緩衝取決於最低允許溫度及凍土體積，不能把全部冰融化熱都當可用餘裕；備援還要考慮電力、循環泵及管路共同失效。定熱流估算只提供簡化時間尺度，實際熱流會隨溫差與流場改變；十小時不是可繼續作業的保證或撤離時限。~After refrigeration stops, frozen ground absorbs heat and warms, potentially losing strength before complete thawing. Useful thermal reserve depends on the allowable temperature and frozen volume; total ice-melting energy is not all usable margin. Backup assessment must also consider common failures of power, circulation pumps and pipework rather than the refrigeration unit alone. The constant-heat estimate gives a simplified time scale; heat flow changes with temperature difference and groundwater, so ten hours is neither an operating guarantee nor an evacuation deadline.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設到指定警戒溫度的可用熱緩衝E=3600 MJ、持續熱流P=0.1 MW=0.1 MJ/s，t=E/P=36000 s=10 h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: With usable reserve E=3600 MJ to a specified warning temperature and heat inflow P=0.1 MW=0.1 MJ/s, t=E/P=36000 s=10 h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以熱模型及實測升溫速率交叉估計緩衝，測試獨立電源與警報回路，核對最暖點而非平均溫度。備援驗證須涵蓋共因失效及現場可到達時間；停機後的開挖限制由冷凍與地工負責人共同核定。~Cross-check reserve using the thermal model and measured warming rate, test independent power and alarms, and assess the warmest point rather than mean temperature. Backup verification covers common-cause failure and response access time; refrigeration and geotechnical leads jointly define excavation restrictions after outages.
units.failure: 冷凍機有備機但共用供電或循環泵時，單一故障仍可能切斷全部冷量，使局部薄壁先軟化。定熱流估算只提供簡化時間尺度，實際熱流會隨溫差與流場改變；十小時不是可繼續作業的保證或撤離時限。~A spare refrigeration unit sharing power or circulation pumps can still lose all cooling from one failure, allowing thin local zones to soften first. The constant-heat estimate gives a simplified time scale; heat flow changes with temperature difference and groundwater, so ten hours is neither an operating guarantee nor an evacuation deadline.
units.misconception: 凍土沒有完全融化前，其支護能力都不會改變。~Frozen-ground support capacity remains unchanged until complete thawing.
units.practice: 備援驗證須涵蓋共因失效及現場可到達時間；停機後的開挖限制由冷凍與地工負責人共同核定。定熱流估算只提供簡化時間尺度，實際熱流會隨溫差與流場改變；十小時不是可繼續作業的保證或撤離時限。~Backup verification covers common-cause failure and response access time; refrigeration and geotechnical leads jointly define excavation restrictions after outages. The constant-heat estimate gives a simplified time scale; heat flow changes with temperature difference and groundwater, so ten hours is neither an operating guarantee nor an evacuation deadline.

units.title: 融沉預估的機理與驗證~Thaw settlement mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 解凍後冰透鏡消失，土骨架可能在外荷載下重新壓密，造成與凍脹不對稱的殘餘沉陷。永久襯砌、管線與周邊地基對此變形的剛度不同，荷載會重新分配；凍結期間表現良好並不代表解凍階段已完成驗證。一維應變積分不包含三維拘束與結構互制，融沉應變必須由代表性試驗界定，不能把其他工程的沉陷率直接移用。~Thawing removes ice lenses and allows the skeleton to reconsolidate under load, leaving settlement that need not reverse prior heave symmetrically. Permanent lining, utilities and neighbouring foundations have different stiffnesses, causing load redistribution. Good behaviour during freezing therefore does not establish satisfactory performance through the thaw stage. One-dimensional strain integration excludes three-dimensional restraint and structural interaction; representative tests must establish thaw strain rather than transferring another project's settlement ratio.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設受影響層厚H=3 m、平均融沉應變εv=0.02，s=εvH=0.06 m=60 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For affected thickness H=3 m and mean thaw-settlement strain εv=0.02, s=εvH=0.06 m=60 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用凍融試驗與分層沉陷計檢查殘餘變形，配合孔壓消散曲線，將地表總沉陷分解到受影響土層。交接需指定解凍後監測終止條件及資產檢查責任；地工設計者確認孔壓與沉陷趨勢穩定後才核准結案。~Use freeze-thaw tests and layered settlement instruments to assess residual deformation, combining pore-pressure dissipation with decomposition of surface settlement by affected layer. Handover specifies post-thaw monitoring closure criteria and asset-inspection responsibility; the geotechnical designer confirms stable pore-pressure and settlement trends before closeout.
units.failure: 解凍後差異沉陷可能使接縫張開，若監測在冷凍停止時即結束，就會漏掉最重要的永久變形。一維應變積分不包含三維拘束與結構互制，融沉應變必須由代表性試驗界定，不能把其他工程的沉陷率直接移用。~Differential thaw settlement may open joints; ending monitoring when refrigeration stops misses the most significant permanent deformation stage. One-dimensional strain integration excludes three-dimensional restraint and structural interaction; representative tests must establish thaw strain rather than transferring another project's settlement ratio.
units.misconception: 凍脹多少，解凍後就必定等量回到原位。~Thawing always reverses frost heave exactly to the original position.
units.practice: 交接需指定解凍後監測終止條件及資產檢查責任；地工設計者確認孔壓與沉陷趨勢穩定後才核准結案。一維應變積分不包含三維拘束與結構互制，融沉應變必須由代表性試驗界定，不能把其他工程的沉陷率直接移用。~Handover specifies post-thaw monitoring closure criteria and asset-inspection responsibility; the geotechnical designer confirms stable pore-pressure and settlement trends before closeout. One-dimensional strain integration excludes three-dimensional restraint and structural interaction; representative tests must establish thaw strain rather than transferring another project's settlement ratio.

units.title: 永久襯砌接管的機理與驗證~Permanent-lining takeover mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 凍土是暫時支護與止水措施，停止冷凍後永久襯砌須獨立承擔設計水壓及土壓。支護接管不能只看混凝土達到抗壓強度，還要確認閉合、接縫水密與抗浮路徑；解凍引起的位移可能同時改變這些界面。水頭乘面積只計該底板的均勻水壓合力，不是整體浮力穩定結論；自重、側向作用及抗拔構件需按同一自由體計算。~Frozen soil provides temporary support and sealing; after cooling ends, permanent lining must independently resist design water and ground pressures. Takeover requires more than concrete compressive strength: closure, joint sealing and uplift load paths also matter, and thaw-induced displacement can change these interfaces simultaneously. Head times area gives a uniform pressure resultant on that slab, not overall uplift stability; self-weight, lateral actions and tension elements require a consistent free-body calculation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設外部水頭h=15 m、受浮投影面積A=8 m²、γw=9.81 kN/m³，U=γwhA=1177 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For external head h=15 m, uplift plan area A=8 m² and γw=9.81 kN/m³, U=γwhA=1177 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 核對永久襯砌閉合與止水試驗，將設計水位、抗浮構件及解凍位移聯合審查，不只驗材料強度。冷凍解除必須設正式停留點，地工、襯砌及營運負責人共同簽認荷載接管與後續監測責任。~Verify permanent closure and joint tests, reviewing design water level, uplift-resisting members and thaw movement together rather than material strength alone. Ending refrigeration requires a formal hold point jointly released by geotechnical, lining and operations leads, confirming load takeover and subsequent monitoring responsibility.
units.failure: 提前停止冷凍可能讓水壓與融沉同時作用於尚未閉合的襯砌，造成滲漏或上浮。水頭乘面積只計該底板的均勻水壓合力，不是整體浮力穩定結論；自重、側向作用及抗拔構件需按同一自由體計算。~Stopping cooling early can apply water pressure and thaw settlement together to an incomplete lining, causing leakage or uplift. Head times area gives a uniform pressure resultant on that slab, not overall uplift stability; self-weight, lateral actions and tension elements require a consistent free-body calculation.
units.misconception: 永久混凝土強度達標就能立即解除所有冷凍支護。~Meeting permanent concrete strength allows immediate removal of all freezing support.
units.practice: 冷凍解除必須設正式停留點，地工、襯砌及營運負責人共同簽認荷載接管與後續監測責任。水頭乘面積只計該底板的均勻水壓合力，不是整體浮力穩定結論；自重、側向作用及抗拔構件需按同一自由體計算。~Ending refrigeration requires a formal hold point jointly released by geotechnical, lining and operations leads, confirming load takeover and subsequent monitoring responsibility. Head times area gives a uniform pressure resultant on that slab, not overall uplift stability; self-weight, lateral actions and tension elements require a consistent free-body calculation.

example: 原創教學例：假設需相變的孔隙水質量m=1000 kg，潛熱Lf=334 kJ/kg，移除潛熱Q=mLf=334000 kJ。若取樣顯示需相變水量增加10%至1100 kg，Q變為367400 kJ，同樣增加10%。這個比較保持潛熱與相變比例固定，只計冰水轉換，不含土粒顯熱、未凍水、鹽分、管路損失或地下水對流。真正冷凍工期需以焓與流動熱輸送模型配合測溫判定，不能把這個能量除以機組額定功率後直接放行開挖。~Original teaching example: assume m=1000 kg of pore water undergoes phase change with latent heat Lf=334 kJ/kg. The latent energy is Q=mLf=334000 kJ. Increasing the water mass by 10% to 1100 kg raises Q to 367400 kJ, also by 10%. This comparison holds latent heat and frozen fraction fixed and covers only ice-water conversion. It excludes soil sensible heat, unfrozen water, salinity, pipe losses and groundwater advection. Actual freezing duration requires an enthalpy and advective-heat model supported by temperatures; dividing this energy by rated plant power does not authorize excavation.
history: 人工地盤凍結透過冷卻與相變暫時增加地層強度並減少滲流，卻同時引入熱量、凍脹及解凍變形問題。本課將凍結管幾何、對流熱輸送、長期潛變與備援冷量分開檢查，再建立從臨時凍土支護轉交永久襯砌的證據與停留點。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2016年：Crossrail發布聯絡通道工法與地質資料，明確說明所列通道未採凍結；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。~Artificial ground freezing temporarily strengthens ground and restricts seepage through cooling and phase change, while introducing thermal, heave and thaw-deformation concerns. The course separately examines pipe geometry, advective heat, creep and cooling reserves, then builds evidence and hold points for transferring support from frozen soil to the permanent lining. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2016: Crossrail publishes its passage-method dataset, explicitly identifying nonuse of freezing in the listed passages; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
